description: This file defines a class 'FillFormatMapper' responsible for mapping fill formatting properties from a Document Object Model (DOM) representation to a rendering library's format, specifically for chart fill styles in MigraDoc.

classes.name: FillFormatMapper
classes.description: A mapper class that converts fill format properties from the DOM model to the rendering engine's format.

methods.name: MapObject
methods.description: Maps the fill format properties from the DOM object to the PdfSharp fill format object, setting color and visibility.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Static helper method that instantiates the mapper and performs the mapping of fill formats.
